text: Agent 0x00. The Director's own bloodhound. Sit.
style: A charismatic field coordinator in his early forties, running his own unauthorised investigation and enjoying being underestimated. British-Ghanaian, raised in Accra and educated in London: a consistent light, educated Ghanaian English accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Warm, mid-low pitch; quick, easy pace. Deflects with charm and keeps turning your questions back on you -- which is exactly why he is on the suspect list.
